name: Onun Gözləri Gülürdü
overview: A young city boy, Ayaz, accidentally goes to the village and meets Nargiz, a tough-minded, free-spirited shepherdess. Their conflict gradually turns into intimacy. But the rural environment, family pressure, and the boundaries of tradition hinder their relationship. Against the backdrop of love, struggle, and choices, both young people discover themselves and each other.
